quizDescription: A psychometric test exploring your intelligences and career interests as you approach stream selection.

items.content: I enjoy working through maths and science problems logically.
I like to test an idea to see whether it is actually true.
I can spot when an argument does not add up.
Organising information into clear steps comes naturally to me.
I like learning an instrument or making my own tunes.
Music helps me concentrate or express how I feel.
I can keep a steady beat and notice rhythm in things.
I pay attention to the melody and instruments in a song.
I enjoy learning how living things grow and survive.
I notice changes in weather, seasons, and the environment.
I like sorting living things into groups or categories.
Caring for plants or animals interests me.
I express my ideas clearly in writing.
I enjoy debates, essays, or learning new languages.
Reading different kinds of texts comes easily to me.
I like playing with words, puns, and wordplay.
I usually understand other people's points of view.
I enjoy leading or organising group work.
I can help settle disagreements between friends.
Working with people gives me energy.
I enjoy activities that need physical skill and coordination.
I prefer hands-on tasks over reading about them.
I am good at sports, crafts, or working with tools.
I remember things better after doing them myself.
I can imagine how an object would look from another angle.
I read maps, charts, and diagrams easily.
I enjoy design, drawing, or the visual arts.
I remember places and layouts well.
I reflect on why I feel or act the way I do.
I am aware of my strengths and weaknesses.
I like to plan and think about my future.
I understand what motivates me.
I think about deep questions like why we are here.
I am interested in ideas about life, meaning, and the universe.
I wonder about right, wrong, and what matters most.
Big-picture questions fascinate me.
I enjoy hands-on technical or mechanical work.
I like using machines, tools, or equipment.
Practical, physical tasks suit me well.
I would enjoy working with my hands or outdoors.
I enjoy researching and analysing problems.
I like understanding the reasons behind things.
Experiments and investigations appeal to me.
I would enjoy studying a science subject deeply.
I enjoy creative activities like art, design, or writing.
I like expressing original ideas in my own way.
I would enjoy performing or creating for others.
I value creativity and self-expression.
I enjoy helping, teaching, or supporting others.
I would like a job where I care for people.
Volunteering or community work appeals to me.
I feel good when I help someone learn or improve.
I enjoy leading, persuading, or organising people.
I like starting and running my own projects.
I am comfortable taking charge and making decisions.
Convincing others of an idea or plan appeals to me.
I enjoy organising information and keeping records.
I like tasks that have clear rules and procedures.
I am accurate and pay attention to detail.
Working with data and spreadsheets appeals to me.
